headline: Findlay open conference play with a fourth straight win
dek: Findlay have beaten Northwood in the first conference match of the season, their fourth win in four, and have conceded only twice all year. Ohio Dominican and Walsh drew the other opener, and Cedarville remain the one programme in the conference yet to score.
displaced_by: Conference play opened on Sep 8 and Findlay won the opener for a fourth win in four.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Ohio Dominican's seven goals have come from five different scorers, but they have conceded nine, more than any other programme, so the spread of their attack is covering for the defence rather than building on it.

wire.line: Findlay have won the first conference match and all four they have played; Cedarville have still not scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have gone past their date with no published result. Kentucky Wesleyan account for most of them, and Walsh's visit to Pitt-Johnstown is the other.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Northwood have lost three times and drawn once, the defeat at Findlay following a home loss to Northern Michigan and one at Purdue Northwest, and have conceded eight goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Cedarville have drawn once and lost three times, conceding six goals and scoring none, after Saturday's defeat at Maryville.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thomas More have won both of their matches at home and lost both away, at Trevecca and at Point Park.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pedro Costa has made thirteen saves for Walsh and been beaten twice, a save percentage of .867.

last_match.line: Ohio Dominican have drawn more often than they have won, and Walsh have yet to win away from home.

next_match.line: Cedarville are still without a goal this season, and Ohio Dominican have not kept a clean sheet in any of their matches.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
